chronology.generation: Three historical generation calls occurred before the new rule, as confirmed by parent/author; existing calls.json retained. No claim of a source search before those calls.

requirements.wrap: Full 360-degree horizontal sky/cloud panorama; choose latitude band or document projection mapping
requirements.style: Bright fresh gentle cartoon-compatible, sky/clouds only, no cities/buildings, avoid large solar focus
requirements.aspectRatioRule: A 2:1 panorama is not rejected for differing from 4:1 delivery. Full-longitude latitude-band crop/resampling may satisfy the target.

stageDecision.first: Selected: direct Kenney skybox-morning.png full-width latitude-band crop; author reports replacement completed.
stageDecision.second: Selected by root: historical bright red-cloud AI candidate, one real image_gen reference edit to fix independent U0 wrap edge. Author owns edit/export/final source QA.
stageDecision.third: Selected by root: exact-official-byte PH Kloofendal Misty Morning 2K HDR, standard SDR full-width band at exposure 2, then one real image_gen light blue-green reference edit preserving original fog layout. This is not programmatic artistic palette grading. Author owns reference edit/export/final source QA.
stageDecision.selectedSourceStatus: Direction selected; generated/edit output identities and final GPU/seam validation remain with author and independent patterns_qa. Audit does not claim those final operations are already complete.
stageDecision.nativeCandidateReasonsForSecond: Actual acquired OGA red/sunset have dark brown/red lower areas and paired bright disks; PH sunset originals are muted blue/violet/gold rather than red-dominant; root selected historical red candidate for fresh bright red-cloud direction after real source comparison. Not rejected for aspect ratio, names or access failures.
stageDecision.nativeCandidateReasonsForThird: Actual PH misty has suitable pure-sky diffuse fog layout and no large solar focus; original palette is pale grey-blue with very little green, so root selected this public source as the basis for light blue-green reference editing.
stageDecision.decisionOwnedBy: root + world_a09; patterns_qa verifies final chosen-source exports
stageDecision.historicalGeneratedFiles: Preserved before-rule history. New reference-edit actions, if performed by author, occur after the new rule and supplementary public-source search.
stageDecision.thirdDerivativeIdentity: AI-edited output is a derivative of the disclosed CC0 reference; it must not be described as unmodified official Poly Haven bytes or as official MD5-matched output. Official MD5 identity only applies to acquired original HDR.
stageDecision.auditorOperations: Source audit only; auditor performed no new generation, no artistic palette grading, no product/source/progress edits, commit or PR mutation.

network.policyMode: Managed restricted network; inherited proxy retained
network.blockedRequestMeaning: Proxy CONNECT denial before an origin response; originHTTPStatus is null. No direct connection, environment/proxy removal, host mapping or policy bypass used.
network.webConnectorMediaMeaning: Image opens returned only text placeholders, not ImageContent pixels. Those placeholders are not visual inspection. ZIP unsupported/type and JPG too-large messages are connector errors, not origin 404/403.
network.legitimateMirrorPurpose: Acquire actual openly licensed original production candidates for source selection and reuse; not download remote media to bypass display restrictions.

validation.finalHorizontalSeamAndMaterialBasicGPUCh: Required after author's final export; this source audit is not a final in-engine review.

skybox-morning.png.palette: Bright pale peach / warm pink, coral-pink clouds, small white sun high at the right
skybox-morning.png.fit: Recommended public source for dusk-peach with full-width latitude-band crop; filename morning is not used to reject its dusk appearance.
skybox-morning.png.status: Author reports first skyline switched to this source on 2026-10-12; final source/GPU verification owned by author and independent QA

skybox-day.png.palette: Pale cool blue with soft white clouds and lavender-blue lower sky
skybox-day.png.fit: Recommended candidate for next batch noon-blue-white-clouds; reserved for #117. Does not directly provide green mist or red clouds.
skybox-day.png.status: Reference only for this first-three batch

skybox-alien.png.palette: Pastel purple/pink with peach lower sky; prominent large white solar disk
skybox-alien.png.fit: Unmodified hue and focal solar disk are a weak match for these three bright fresh period-specific skies.
skybox-alien.png.status: Not selected by author for current first-three batch

skybox-night.png.palette: Dark deep blue, wispy dark clouds, small star specks and bright white disk
skybox-night.png.fit: Native night treatment is outside these three bright dusk/sunset/dawn requirements; useful for a later night task.

skybox-space.png.palette: Dark navy-to-purple starfield, no terrestrial cloud band
skybox-space.png.fit: Native starfield is outside requested sky-and-clouds dusk/sunset/dawn; later space use possible.

cloudy_red.png.palette: Red/pink cloud bands over brown-red upper sky, small bright red-white solar point; dark lower hemisphere and mirrored low glow
cloudy_red.png.fit: Closest acquired native red-cloud candidate. Keep the full 2048-pixel longitude; choose sky-only latitude band and assess brightness/softness. CC0 permits tonal adaptation.
cloudy_red.png.status: Handed to author for actual crop/brightness/GPU comparison; no blanket rejection

cloudy_sunset.png.palette: Orange cloud banks, brown-orange sky, distinct glowing golden solar disk; dark lower hemisphere
cloudy_sunset.png.fit: Native sunset candidate; a full-width upper latitude band can remove dark lower area. Need assess large solar focal spot and bright fresh palette in final view.
cloudy_sunset.png.status: Candidate, not product-selected by this audit

cloudy_clear_sunset.png.palette: Purple upper sky, red-pink thin low cloud band, prominent yellow solar glow
cloudy_clear_sunset.png.fit: Period-appropriate panorama, but stronger purple cast and focal sun than requested; could adapt under CC0.

cloudy_clear_sunrise.png.palette: Grey-blue with warm gold-white light around conspicuous solar disk
cloudy_clear_sunrise.png.fit: Eligible sunrise panorama; native warm grey/gold does not directly equal blue-green fog.

cloudy_sunrise.png.palette: Cold grey-blue clouds with narrow warm bright horizon, scattered dense cloud forms
cloudy_sunrise.png.fit: Eligible morning cloud source; native dense clouds and grey tone need comparison/adaptation.

cloudy_dawn.png.palette: Grey/violet dawn cloud masses, muted pink horizon and large diffuse white light
cloudy_dawn.png.fit: Native dawn is not clear blue-green mist; dense cloud texture is a visible styling tradeoff.

cloudy_early_morning.png.palette: Blue upper sky with pink/grey clouds and strong low solar glow
cloudy_early_morning.png.fit: Eligible morning panorama; not native green mist.

cloudy_green.png.palette: Emerald/bright green sky and green clouds, white point light
cloudy_green.png.fit: Actual green candidate, but vivid fantasy green is stronger than fresh thin dawn mist. Could desaturate/soften under CC0.

cloudy_light_green.png.palette: Muted grey/slate blue-green sky, dense clouds, small warm-white sun; black lower hemisphere
cloudy_light_green.png.fit: Actual native hue is cooler/greyer than filename suggests. Full-width sky band is usable; need brightness and cloud-density comparison.
cloudy_light_green.png.status: Handed to author as possible dawn base

cloudy_mist.png.palette: Cool grey/lavender fog with broad diffuse white light and very little cloud definition
cloudy_mist.png.fit: Eligible diffuse mist base. CC0 permits a gentle blue-green palette adjustment; white light remains a potential focus.
cloudy_mist.png.status: Handed to author as possible dawn base

cloudy_hazy.png.palette: Warm brown/grey haze and visible mottled clouds with small white light
cloudy_hazy.png.fit: Haze source is eligible but native warm brown hue is not blue-green morning.

cloudy_chaotic.png.palette: Pale mauve/gold cloudy sky, complex dense cloud forms and diffuse warm light
cloudy_chaotic.png.fit: Eligible soft warm source, but no native blue-green mist or red-dominant cloud palette.

cloudy_clear_afternoon.png.palette: Bright cool blue sky with sparse white clouds, sharp glowing near-horizon sun

cloudy_clear_night.png.palette: Near-black/dark grey sky with warm bright disk and sparse clouds

cloudy_dark_blue.png.palette: Deep blue/lavender sky with large dense white cloud puffs and bright white light

cloudy_dusk.png.palette: Pink/mauve sky with dense turbulent cloud textures
cloudy_dusk.png.fit: Actual dusk source, but native pink-purple and busy cloud texture do not directly match red-dominant fresh sunset.

cloudy_inverted_colors.png.palette: Grey/black sky, very white clouds, yellow/red horizon stripe
cloudy_inverted_colors.png.fit: Native inverted/high-contrast treatment is unlike gentle fresh current-three direction.

cloudy_moody.png.palette: Muted grey-violet upper sky with cloudy horizon and small strong light
cloudy_moody.png.fit: Eligible cloudy source; no native blue-green thin fog.

cloudy_night.png.palette: Dark blue-violet night clouds and pale warm disk
cloudy_night.png.fit: Native night treatment is outside these bright three period targets.

cloudy_noon.png.palette: Bright blue/white-cloud sky, intensely glowing low sun
cloudy_noon.png.fit: Useful future noon candidate, but current dawn requires thin fog and softer focus.

cloudy_obscured_sun.png.fit: Additional native cool source for dawn comparison; closest newly acquired gentle blue sky, but no native green cast or uniform thin mist.
cloudy_obscured_sun.png.status: Handed to author as possible dawn base

cloudy_purple.png.palette: Strong purple sky with white-grey clouds and white point light
cloudy_purple.png.fit: Native strong-purple hue is outside requested fresh red/dawn directions; CC0 adaptation is permitted.
